newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Family of a British nurse held in Saudi jail charged with murdering an Australian colleaque thank Saudi officials for providing her and her co-accused with "best possible" legal representation.
- Japan completes delivery of five crude supertankers to National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia.
- Riyad Bank receives 115 million riyals of a loan it had extended to Saudi Arabian Airlines.
- Exports through King Fahd industrial port in Jubail were eight times more than imports until May 1996.
